evidence: log loss +0.0140 (95% interval +0.0047 to +0.0220). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

280 picks, ROI +1.8% (95% interval -7.2% to +10.2%), win rate 60.7% against a break-even 59.0%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 10% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.14 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,829 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,739; a 1% edge takes 43,461. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
